en: When a keyboard user tabs to these elements, nothing on screen shows where they are.
Add a :focus-visible style (outline or ring) with at least 3:1 contrast against the background.
pt: Quem navega pelo teclado chega nesses elementos e nada na tela mostra onde está.
Adicione um estilo :focus-visible (contorno ou anel) com contraste de pelo menos 3:1 com o fundo.
issues.title: Focus is not visible
issues.detail: When a keyboard user tabs to these elements, nothing on screen shows where they are.
issues.fixText: Add a :focus-visible style (outline or ring) with at least 3:1 contrast against the background.

en: At 320 CSS pixels wide (400% zoom on a laptop) the page scrolls sideways.
Let the element wrap or shrink: max-width: 100%, flexible grids, overflow-x: auto on tables and code.
pt: O conteúdo não se ajusta em 320px
Com 320 pixels CSS de largura (zoom de 400% num notebook) a página rola pro lado.
Deixe o elemento quebrar ou encolher: max-width: 100%, grids flexíveis, overflow-x: auto em tabelas e código.
issues.title: Content does not reflow at 320px
issues.detail: At 320 CSS pixels wide (400% zoom on a laptop) the page scrolls sideways.
issues.fixText: Let the element wrap or shrink: max-width: 100%, flexible grids, overflow-x: auto on tables and code.

en: The first Tab stop is not a link to the main content, so keyboard users go through the whole menu on every page.
Add “Skip to content” as the first focusable element, pointing to <main id="content">. eMAG 1.5 asks for it.
pt: A primeira parada do Tab não é um link pro conteúdo principal, então quem usa teclado passa pelo menu inteiro em toda página.
Adicione “Ir para o conteúdo” como primeiro elemento focável, apontando pra <main id="conteudo">. O eMAG pede isso na recomendação 1.5.
issues.title: No skip link
issues.detail: The first Tab stop is not a link to the main content, so keyboard users go through the whole menu on every page.
issues.fixText: Add “Skip to content” as the first focusable element, pointing to <main id="content">. eMAG 1.5 asks for it.

en: With “reduce motion” on in the system, these animations still run. They can cause nausea for people with vestibular disorders.
Wrap the animation in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), or stop it under reduce.
pt: A animação ignora o movimento reduzido
Com “reduzir movimento” ligado no sistema, essas animações continuam. Elas podem causar enjoo em quem tem distúrbio vestibular.
Coloque a animação dentro de @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), ou pare ela no modo reduce.
issues.title: Animation ignores reduced motion
issues.detail: With “reduce motion” on in the system, these animations still run. They can cause nausea for people with vestibular disorders.
issues.fixText: Wrap the animation in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), or stop it under reduce.
